### Added

- klausgateway: the agentgateway HTTPRoute now includes `/channels/slack` when `klausGateway.slack.enabled` is true, exposing the Slack Events API webhook endpoint through the data-plane ([#132](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/132)).
- agent-sandbox: bundle the agent-sandbox controller, opt-in ([#124](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/124)).

### Fixed

- agent-sandbox: keep the PSS mutate policy across install rollback ([#130](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/130)).
